title: peanut butter oatmeal cookies 🥜 (better than your mom’s) ✨full recipe...
description: peanut butter oatmeal cookies 🥜 (better than your mom’s) ✨full recipe in my bio  like pb cookies with oatmeal, not oatmeal cookies with pb (to be clear) besides the fact that these are chewy, crinkle-top cookie perfection, my favorite part of these easy cookies is that 🥣they’re a ONE BOWL recipe  no sifting, no seperate whisking, just dump (as directed PLS) and go 🎁they’re perfectly peanut buttery with that oaty chew, great for cookie boxes, friendsgivings, and holiday dessert tables . . . . . . #peanutbuttercookies #peanutbutteraddict #cookiebox #holidaybaking #easycookies
transcript: The best compliment you can give a baker is to tell them their cookies are better than your moms. That is if your mom makes good cookies. These are my peanut butter oatmeal cookies. After eating them, my neighbor told me her mom makes the best peanut butter cookies and now mine are better. Job done. Personally, I love a cookie with some oats in it. Gives that texture with a little extra chew. They're perfectly peanut buttery without being overwhelming because sometimes the OG peanut butter cookies are a little too much. Oh and if you're feeling extra, add a little marshmallow fluff frosting. As always, you can find the full recipe in my bio. Perfectly chewy. I love how they crinkle on top. They're so simple and they make like 20 cookies. Can you do better than that? I think not.
